title: Read browser diagnostics
responsibility: Read and validate the browser diagnostics written for one check attempt.

inputs.name: readBrowserDiagnostics.directory
inputs.description: Directory for this check attempt; only its browser-errors.ndjson file is read.

outputs.name: readBrowserDiagnostics
outputs.description: Parsed browserErrors when the file contains valid nonblank JSON lines. Returns an empty object for a missing or empty file, or a failure message for a nonregular file, a file over 2000000 bytes, read failure or any invalid line; partial results are not returned.
